# OSS Security Knowledge Base Update Proposal for `litellm` (PyPI)

## Summary

The evidence contains **4 distinct vulnerability records** affecting the legitimate `litellm` package (PyPI: `pkg:pypi/litellm`). All are application-level vulnerabilities in the LiteLLM proxy/library — none are malicious-package/typosquat advisories. Each has a unique CVE and distinct root cause.

---

## Distinct Vulnerabilities

### 1. CVE-2024-4888 — Arbitrary File Deletion
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| GHSA | GHSA-3xr8-qfvj-9p9j |
| Severity | HIGH |
| Affected | `litellm` < 1.35.36 |
| Fixed in | 1.35.36 |
| Root Cause | Insufficient path validation allows unauthenticated arbitrary file deletion |
| Reference | [huntr.com bounty](https://huntr.com/bounties/48461d89-cf13-4ad3-a43e-0d37da08fc6c) |

### 2. CVE-2024-2952 — Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI)
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| GHSA | GHSA-46cm-pfwv-cgf8 |
| Severity | CRITICAL |
| Affected | `litellm` < 1.34.42 |
| Fixed in | 1.34.42 |
| Root Cause | SSTI in `/completions` endpoint enables code execution via crafted template input |
| Reference | [PR #2941](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/2941), commit `8a1cdc9` |

### 3. CVE-2024-6825 — Remote Code Execution (RCE)
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| GHSA | GHSA-53gh-p8jc-7rg8 |
| Severity | HIGH |
| Affected | `litellm` 1.40.3.dev2 – 1.40.12 |
| Fixed in | Commit `441c727` (post-1.40.12) |
| Root Cause | Unsafe deserialization/eval in `litellm/utils.py` (line 2818) allows RCE |
| Reference | [huntr.com bounty](https://huntr.com/bounties/1d98bebb-6cf4-46c9-87c3-d3b1972973b5) |

### 4. CVE-2026-35029 — Privilege Escalation via Unrestricted Proxy Config Endpoint
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| GHSA | GHSA-53mr-6c8q-9789 |
| Severity | HIGH |
| Affected | `litellm` < 1.83.0 |
| Fixed in | 1.83.0 |
| Root Cause | Proxy configuration endpoint lacks authorization checks, enabling privilege escalation |

---

## Key Observations

- **No duplicates or aliases**: All four records have distinct CVEs and describe different vulnerability classes (file deletion, SSTI, RCE, privilege escalation).
- **No malicious package**: All advisories target the legitimate `litellm` package by BerriAI — no typosquat or supply-chain attack indicators.
- **Recurring pattern**: Multiple critical/high-severity issues in the proxy server component suggest the proxy attack surface warrants ongoing monitoring.
- **Version overlap**: CVE-2024-2952 (fixed 1.34.42) and CVE-2024-4888 (fixed 1.35.36) overlap in affected range; users below 1.35.36 are exposed to both.

---

## Recommended KB Actions

1. **Add/update entries** for all four CVEs with correct affected ranges and fix versions.
2. **Tag `litellm`** with risk indicators: exposed-HTTP-proxy, template-injection-history, RCE-history.
3. **Advise minimum safe version**: ≥ 1.83.0 (addresses all four vulnerabilities).
4. **No malicious-package entry needed** — this is not a supply-chain compromise.
